quotes.text: For the Commands review queue, the user wants a manually handled revision to stay out of direct and group queues across patch versions until they undo that choice. The recorded implementation keys saved state by normalized user and revision ID, which explains why a new patch version does not clear it. This manual choice is separate from Phabricator review status.
